| Check | Result | Detail |
|-------|--------|--------|
| B1 No exact duplicate rows | ✅ PASS | dups=0 |

**Notes:**
- 40 rows have `price = 0` and `line_total = 0` (0.009% of rows). These are retained as legitimate zero-price lines (promotional / sample items). All 35 affected products also appear at non-zero prices elsewhere. They will be excluded from monetary aggregations via `line_total > 0` at feature engineering time.

## Revenue Impact of Previous Join (Archived)

The previously generated `transactions_clean.csv` used a row-level join on `(InvoiceID, product_id)`. This is documented here for audit purposes but the file **must not be used for any analytical computation**.

| Metric | `transactions_clean.csv` | Normalised model | Difference |
|--------|------------------------|-----------------|-----------|
| Row count | 442,587 | 431,263 (fact_ii) | -11,324 |
| Total `line_total` | £9,388,019.84 | **£9,307,314.40** | -£80,705.44 |
| Fan-out | 5,292 keys over-multiplied | 0 fan-out | — |
